title: Lamb chop traybake with apple and spinach

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or a traditional cupboard item such as wholegrain mustard and olive oil.

supermarket.reason: Lamb chops, Bramleys, new potatoes and bagged spinach are all everyday Tesco lines.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a single roasting tray and simple roasting.

works.reason: The timings, oven temperature and quantities give cooked potatoes and chops for four, and the Bramleys deliberately collapse into a sharp sauce for the lamb.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is fair for halving the potatoes, cutting the onions and apples and rubbing the chops, and the 35-minute cook matches the 20 plus 15 minutes in the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: The hero spinach is only 200g for four, about a spoonful each once wilted, and is stirred in at the very end of what is really a lamb chop and potato traybake, so it reads as an afterthought rather than the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Chops, potatoes, onions, apple and greens make a proper family dinner.
